opening.argument: The promotion is presented alongside BitConnect account, wallet, and deposit interfaces, including a receiving address and QR code. The description advertises a “$100000 BITCONNET NEWBIE GIVEAWAY!”, while the displayed wallet page provides a visible mechanism for cryptocurrency transfers within the depicted account system. Together, these observable elements support the position that this is a low-barrier reward or asset-acquisition scam. The evidence does not establish the giveaway’s conditions, required payments, eligibility rules, or any completed transaction, so it does not prove that anyone transferred funds or suffered a loss. Those limits do not erase the combination of a giveaway promotion and a working-looking receiving interface; they define what can be claimed from the available material.
